examples.body:
# Market observation

Mega-cap equities are still grinding higher, but market breadth is weakening.
Volatility is picking up, cross-asset correlations are rising, and small-cap
liquidity feels poor. No direct transaction-cost or credit-spread measurements
are available for this observation.
